world_seed_type: u64; controls the public stream only
algorithm_seed_type: separate u64; never used by generator
context_bound_transition: context 0 changes with regime; context 1 remains at phase A to measure unaffected-key retention and interference
irrelevant_modifier: At even steps, a marker sentence varies independently of target and appears in the visible surface.
counterfactual_query_only: For fixed seed/split/family/track/feedback/step, rotations 0,1,2 have identical query/candidates and all three distinct targets.
reset_boundary: Each world starts with fresh arm state; no cross-world adaptive carryover.
validation: Reconstruct target independently from serialized world_state and reject every mismatch.
